title: Seller Performance Standing Policy: The Monthly Level Evaluation
content:
**Clause.** On the evaluation day each month the seller is placed at the highest level whose every gate is met; a seller who meets no other level is placed at Below Standard Level. A level's gates are its maximum order defect rate (or, below the low-volume order threshold, its maximum defect count), maximum late shipment rate, maximum seller cancellation rate, minimum valid tracking rate, minimum trailing 12-month transactions and sales, and minimum and maximum profile age; a gate valued not applicable is not checked. A seller's first evaluation moves the record from onboarding to good standing at the level so computed. The level applies from the evaluation date until the next evaluation and is the level other programs read for that period. An evaluation never changes the status of a suspended, under appeal, deactivated or closed record, but still records its level.

## Limits held against each level

At each level of Seller Performance Standing the order defect limit, the late shipment limit and the cancellation limit used at the evaluation are that level's own highest order defect rate, highest late shipment rate and highest seller cancellation rate. The rates are those measured over the rolling windows ending the day before the evaluation date: the order defect rate, the late shipment rate, the seller cancellation rate and the valid tracking rate.

## The evaluation as condition and result

| Condition at the evaluation | Result |
|---|---|
| The seller meets every gate of one or more levels | Placed at the highest of those levels |
| The seller meets no level other than Below Standard Level | Placed at Below Standard Level |
| A gate of a level is valued not applicable | That gate is not checked for that level |
| It is the seller's first evaluation | The record moves from onboarding to good standing at the level computed |
| The record is suspended, under appeal, deactivated or closed | Its status is unchanged; its level is still recorded |

The evaluation also records the date of this evaluation and the date of the next one; the level so placed is the one in force until that next evaluation.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A seller's metrics meet every gate of Standard Level and of Above Standard Level, but the seller's valid tracking rate falls short of the minimum set for Top Rated Level. The seller is placed at Above Standard Level, the highest level whose every gate is met, and that level applies from this evaluation date until the next evaluation. Had the same seller's record been suspended at the time, the record would remain suspended, with Above Standard Level recorded as its level.
